description:
`tests/fz2_cli.rs::coverage_environment` duplicates the production decision in `src/aot_link.rs::coverage_env_present`: both inspect `CARGO_LLVM_COV`, `LLVM_PROFILE_FILE`, and coverage markers in `RUSTFLAGS` and `CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS`. The integration test therefore predicts what `fz2` will do instead of observing the subprocess's production path, and the two copies can drift.

Delete the integration-test predicate. Make the AOT CLI assertion consume the completed `["fz","compiler2","aot","resolve_runtime_archive"]` telemetry span, which already reports the selected `source` (`embedded`, `isolated_coverage_build`, or `override`). Preserve the existing production-plan unit contracts and the successful-link/run assertion; do not add another test-side derivation of production environment policy.

The contributor-facing test instructions also understate CI. README currently only names `cargo test --workspace`, while CI runs:

```text
cargo test --workspace --doc
cargo llvm-cov --all-features --workspace \
  --fail-under-lines "$(cat .coverage-threshold)" \
  --json --summary-only --output-path coverage.json
```

The coverage command exercises the workspace's ordinary Cargo test targets, including the `fz` and `fz-runtime` unit targets, `fz2`, and integration targets `aot_variadic_open`, `fixture_matrix`, and `fz2_cli`; cargo-llvm-cov sets `CARGO_LLVM_COV=1`. Document that exact gate, the target inventory, and `CARGO_LLVM_COV=1 cargo test --test fz2_cli` as the focused reproducer for the coverage-sensitive AOT path.

## Checks

- `tests/fz2_cli.rs` contains no copy of the coverage-environment predicate.
- The CLI test reads exactly one completed runtime-archive-resolution span and validates the source reported by production telemetry.
- `cargo test --test fz2_cli` passes.
- `CARGO_LLVM_COV=1 cargo test --test fz2_cli` passes.
- Contributor documentation names the doctest step, exact coverage command, coverage threshold, and all current Cargo test targets.
title: Remove the duplicated coverage-environment oracle and document the exact CI test gate
